about_the_game:
WOLFMAN, is a survival horror game about hunting a Wolfman. You can fight alone or with your friends against a Wolfman controlled by artificial intelligence or a real player.

This survival horror game called WOLFMAN is about hunting one of the most terrifying creatures in history. The Wolfman is either controlled by artificial intelligence or by one of the players. In both cases, you will face a deadly enemy that will test your skills, courage, and determination to the fullest. To succeed in this mission, you need to be both smart and brave.

According to eyewitnesses, the Wolfman is so massive that it challenges the limits of human imagination, and its strength rivals the most powerful creatures in nature. Moreover, this creature has the ability to disappear without leaving a trace, almost like a ghost. For years, hunters, adventurers, and scientists have tried every method to find this legendary monster. But none of them have been able to prove its existence for sure. Until now.

You are a Wolfman hunter determined to uncover this dark secret. Your mission is not only to end the rumors, but also to eliminate humanity’s deepest fears and prove that the Wolfman is not just a tale or a product of imagination. Its presence is so real that the cold truth will seep into your bones. But you must not forget how dangerous this mission is, because trying to hunt this creature means feeling the cold breath of death on your neck at all times.

You are setting out into the most remote and unexplored wilderness of Portugal. These lands are known for their mysterious forests, steep mountains, and deep valleys. But behind this beauty lies the brutal reality of predators like the Wolfman and the merciless wilderness. To survive, you must use your ammunition wisely, examine the terrain carefully, and always stay alert to the dangers of the wild. When night falls and the howls of the Wolfman echo through the forest, not only your courage but also your survival instincts will keep you standing.

At every step, you face the possibility of encountering one of the most dangerous predators in nature. Escaping the deadly traps set for you will only be possible through a combination of skill and intelligence. This journey will confront you not only with the Wolfman, but also with your own fears. If you fail, the wilderness of Portugal will consume you forever.

This will be both a struggle for survival and a journey into the darkest corners of the human soul. Your mission is to not get lost in the darkness and to hunt the Wolfman, erasing the thin line between legend and reality once and for all.

Play Against an AI-Controlled Wolfman

  • Form your hunting team or set out alone

    Fight in dark forests against a ruthless Wolfman controlled by artificial intelligence.

  • Arm yourself with modern equipment

    You must be equipped with the latest technology, weapons, and detectors to survive.

  • Use your intelligence and surroundings to gain the advantage

    Set traps, analyze the creature’s tracks, and turn environmental conditions in your favor.

  • Be cautious of other threats in the wild

    It’s not just the Wolfman. Nature will also test you. Night vision, navigation, and resource usage are critical.

  • Manage your resources strategically

    Ammunition and health kits are limited. You must know when to fight and when to escape.

Play Against a Player-Controlled Wolfman (4 vs 1 Mode)

  • 4 Hunters vs 1 Wolfman – a tension-filled battle

    While one player controls the deadly Wolfman, the others try to hunt it down.

  • Work together as hunters
    Move as a team, share your roles, and develop strategies to trap the creature.

  • Spread fear as the Wolfman

    Become the creature of the night, use stealth, set ambushes, and hunt the hunters one by one.

  • Dynamic gameplay and high tension

    The player-controlled Wolfman can completely shift the balance of the game with unpredictable moves.

  • Test your intelligence and reflexes against real players

    In this mode, being strong is not enough. You must also be smart and ruthless.

General Features

  • Single-player mode.

  • 1–4 player online co-op mode against an AI-controlled Wolfman

  • Multiplayer mode where players can control the Wolfman (4 Hunters vs 1 Wolfman)

  • Intense atmosphere, modern equipment, resource management, and tactical gameplay

  • The game is being developed on the Unreal Engine 5.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content not suitable for all ages or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content.
